negative_findings.description: Direct Slovene queries for a bank switching core-banking supplier ('slovenska banka zamenjala ponudnika bancnega sistema', 'jedrni bancni sistem') returned no press article naming a supplier switch - only Banka Slovenije regulatory pages plus consumer-impact coverage of the BKS Bank migration.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero direct vendor-switch stories surfaced via general web search; the only migration evidence is indirect (customer harm reporting).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell rationale in reverse: Slovenian press does cover these events, but almost never as procurement stories - they surface as outage/complaint stories. Collection keyword sets must therefore target failure symptoms (trajniki, izpiski, napake, prenova sistema, migracija), not procurement vocabulary.

negative_findings.description: Finance.si, the outlet most likely to carry contract values and displaced-incumbent detail, did not surface any relevant article through open web search; its content appears to sit behind subscription and is poorly indexed for this topic.
negative_findings.result_summary: Seed query aimed at Finance.si returned unrelated vendor and Banka Slovenije pages, no Finance.si article.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The highest-value source in this cell is effectively invisible to open search. Without a subscription plus site-native search, the run will systematically under-report Slovenian deal detail.

negative_findings.description: Attempted to locate dedicated Slovenian IT/B2B trade blogs beyond Monitor and Racunalniske novice (searched for Poslovni svet, Slotech-type community/trade sites). No additional Slovene-language banking-IT trade blog was confirmed; the one strong match returned was Croatian (ICTbusiness.info).
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovenian IT trade-media landscape appears to be a narrow two-to-three outlet field, not a blog ecosystem.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Reduces expected source count for this cell and raises the weight that must be placed on Monitor/Monitor Pro, Racunalniske novice and vendor-published journals.

negative_findings.description: The Moje finance URL was inferred from the Casnik Finance publisher structure rather than confirmed in a search result; only the publisher relationship was confirmed (via the Slovene Wikipedia entry on Finance).
negative_findings.result_summary: Publisher confirmed, exact subdomain not confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Flagged so the deterministic liveness pass treats this URL as a hypothesis and falls back to finance.si site navigation if it fails.

coverage_gaps.description: No licensed access path established to the two paywalled cornerstones of this cell: Casnik Finance (finance.si, Moje finance, Manager) and the STA wire.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Procure a Finance.si subscription and evaluate an STA wire or media-monitoring contract (e.g. a Slovenian clipping service); until then, rely on downstream free reprints and label the resulting coverage as partial.

coverage_gaps.description: Only current-web coverage was reached; no Slovenian newspaper archive (Delo/Dnevnik/Vecer digital archives, Digitalna knjiznica Slovenije dLib) was explored for historical bank-IT supplier reporting.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated pass over dLib.si and the paid Delo/Dnevnik archives for pre-2015 tenders and incumbent history, which anchors current displacement analysis.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-Ljubljana outlets (Vecer in Maribor, regional business weeklies) and RTVSLO's business desk were not covered in this pass; regional banks and savings banks (hranilnice) are typically covered there rather than nationally.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the cell with vecer.com, rtvslo.si/gospodarstvo and hranilnica-focused coverage; add Slovene terms 'hranilnica', 'Delavska hranilnica', 'Primorska hranilnica'.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovene procurement/technology vocabulary for this domain was only partially exercised - terms not yet searched include 'javno narocilo', 'razpis', 'izvajalec', 'sistemski integrator', 'procesni center', 'karticno poslovanje', 'POS terminali', 'jedrni bancni sistem', 'zaledni sistem'.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a second local-language sweep with the full glossary across najdi.si Novice, Monitor and Racunalniske novice site search before declaring the cell complete.

coverage_gaps.description: Much of the freely accessible Slovenian IT trade content (Racunalniske novice, SRC InfoSRC) is vendor-supplied advertorial, but no method is yet defined for separating editorial from paid placement.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Define a provenance flag at collection time (byline present, 'promocijsko sporocilo' / 'oglasno sporocilo' marker, vendor-hosted) and downweight credibility accordingly.

brief: Slovenian-language press on bank vendor deals is a narrow but high-signal field: one business daily (Finance.si) and one wire (STA) hold most of the deal detail but are both paywalled and near-invisible to open web search, while the free layer - Delo and Dnevnik gospodarstvo, Racunalniske novice, Monitor/Monitor Pro - carries vendor-named project write-ups that are frequently advertorial in origin. The strongest independent find in this pass is investigative outlet Necenzurirano.si, whose documented reporting on the failed BKS Bank core-system migration surfaces exactly the implementation friction that neither bank nor supplier publishes; Zurnal24, Siol.net and 24ur corroborate and date such events. Critically, procurement-vocabulary searches return nothing - Slovenian coverage of supplier changes appears almost exclusively as customer-harm and outage reporting, so collection keyword sets must target failure symptoms alongside contract terms. Recommended next steps are a Finance.si subscription, an STA or clipping-service feed, a full Slovene glossary sweep, and extension to regional outlets and newspaper archives.
